notes: No bracketed old names on this half. Moosewood Avenue is printed 'MOOSEWOOD' and 'PARK' along its north part and 'AVENUE' along the diagonal south of Yonkers; the due-south leg from Hopple to Sutter is unlabelled and taken as Moosewood (1904 key map: Moosewood Av. continues south to Hopple, then Linden). 'SEIGER' (Seiger Street) has a first letter shaped like '3'; could be read GEIGER (1904 key map: GEIGER). 'CUMMINGS ... ST.' kept as printed (usual spelling Cummins). HOLLIDAY is overprinted by a large subdivision lettering. Shetland Avenue ends at Sterling Avenue: east of Sterling the band along y~3170-3215 is a row of lots (140, 68, 43, 142, 167, 42, 15, 168), not a street. Yonkers is 50 ft at both ends but only ~25 ft wide (north half) between x~600 and ~3200, so its centre there is ~20 px north of the full-width centre. Unnamed alleys not recorded: a 20 ft way from Bowling Green to Yonkers between Sterling and Moosewood, a 10 ft alley from the north line to Yonkers between Moosewood and Beekman (crosses Austin), a 15 ft diagonal alley east of Raleigh, an 18 ft passage at y~4793 west of Moosewood. Alabama Avenue starts at x~5510 (west of that only a 6 in. water pipe on a lot line) and has no street junction on this half. Hopple crosses the B&O and Mill Creek and runs on into 22-34R; east of Beekman only the unnamed creek-side 'STREET' meets it (T at x~5412). The ~100 px strip opposite it south of Hopple (dimension 258.71) is a parcel, not a street. Gutter overlap with 22-34R (R x = L x - ~5560): no street intersections fall in it (only Hopple and Alabama pass through). Moosewood Avenue is printed 'MOOSEWOOD' and 'PARK' (with a gap) on its north part and 'AVENUE' south of Yonkers; it could be read 'Moosewood Park Avenue'. Beekman narrows from ~60 ft to ~50 ft south of Pulte and jogs at Denham (two points recorded). Cummings/Carll/Baltimore: at Casper, Carll's centreline (y~6650) and Baltimore's (y~6690) are only ~40 px apart; Carll merges into Baltimore just west of Casper.
